milestones.outcome: The core decides image admission, served-address matching, fetch/redirect/credential admission, display size and state with stale rejection, tested without Qt.
exit_criteria: Core tests cover every admission, matching, hop, credential, sizing, bound and state rule with negative controls; core-only and both architecture-boundary tests pass.
milestones.boundary: Pure core policy and tests; no host, adapter or Qt change.

milestones.outcome: The application host resolves, fetches, decodes and caches images on a bounded cancellable lane and publishes a provider-free image projection.
exit_criteria: Host tests with fake ports and the manual executor cover concurrency, queue and cache bounds, cancellation, stale and duplicate completions, cache hits without requests, and shutdown with work in flight.
milestones.boundary: Application ports, host lane, memory cache and projection; adapters are fakes.

milestones.outcome: GitHub resolution reads, native HTTPS image fetches under the credential and redirect policy, and the restricted Qt Gui decoder implement the host ports.
exit_criteria: Loopback contract tests prove AC04 and the fetch-side AC03 bounds; decoder tests prove the format restriction and decode bounds; the CLI shape and fixture replay are covered.
milestones.boundary: GitHub adapter, decode adapter and their contract tests.

milestones.outcome: The shipped reader shows images inline with loading, reflow, sizing, HiDPI, animation, links, accessibility and fallback, composed through the real application with packaged decoders.
exit_criteria: Qt and composed fixture courses prove AC01, AC02 and AC05; packaging ships the qgif and qjpeg plugins; documentation and resealed composition contracts agree.
milestones.boundary: Qt presentation, composition, packaging plugin list, fixtures and documentation.

milestones.outcome: A bounded owner-private on-disk image cache in the profile serves images across restarts and is removed by profile purge.
exit_criteria: Tests prove AC06: bounds, isolation, expiry, restart without request, purge removal.
milestones.boundary: Disk cache port, adapter and purge integration.

milestones.outcome: The live BPR-Test course, the frozen attended build and the owner's verdict close the RFC.
exit_criteria: AC07 live course passes within the rate-limit margin and the owner answers the attended question; AC08 gates pass; every criterion has recorded evidence.
milestones.boundary: Verification, attended review and closeout; owner acceptance cannot be self-certified.
